user_statement: Ok chat, I approve the completion plan and the proposed ball-quality criteria. I want to run this in a new session, so please generate me a title for this session (using the structure of all of the other sessions titles) and give me a handoff so the new session knows exactly where we are at

approved_plan_snapshot.hash_representation: exact git show commit:path bytes; excludes subsequent approval-status annotations

authorized_scope: Accept the plan numerical ball-quality criteria for the three complete curated possessions, without revising historical player or experiment gates.
Execute the fixed reference preparation, retained-baseline delivery and integration campaign in the next session.
Prepare up to 3840 new NBA frame judgments across three training games including SAC and one fresh validation game; retain accepted existing training roles and complete permitted curated references.
After new reference acceptance and recipe freeze, run one primary WASB fit and at most one conditional higher-resolution fit under the exact plan trigger; no repeat fitting proposal required.
Apply standing authorization for routine implementation, proportionate validation and local integration; preserve prior baselines and failures.
human_new_reference_acceptance: required before fitting; not supplied by campaign approval
human_final_trajectory_acceptance: required before adoption; not supplied by campaign approval
protected_evaluation_boundary: 75 holdout frames plus 150 buffer positions stay closed until candidate/policy freeze and separate explicit authorization.
historical_experiments_and_reviews: unchanged; failed verifier remains rejected and prior accepted reviews remain accepted
